title: Deep Spec normalized findings (contract 2)
description: Per-backend verification result file, written to <record>/<phase>/<stage>/deep-spec-verify/<backend>.json. Canonically sorted, byte-deterministic for a given IR and environment. Nothing is silently dropped: every obligation or scenario a backend did not check appears in skipped[] with a reason.

backend.description: Backend identifier; equals the findings file basename without .json.

irVersion.description: irVersion of the consumed IR document.

irHash.description: sha256 of the canonical (key-sorted) JSON serialization of the consumed IR. Cross-checking only compares sibling findings files with an identical irHash.

method.description: exhaustive: full symbolic check (SMT). bounded: bounded model checking (Quint+Apalache). simulation: seeded random simulation (quint run). static: deterministic non-solver computation (reference/structure checks).

inputs.description: Exact inputs this document was computed from: record-relative artifact paths with their content hashes, canonically sorted by artifact. Static (refcheck) documents MUST populate this and derive irHash from it; refinement documents MUST list every consumed model and map.

checked.description: Check families (or targets) that ran and found nothing. Present so a clean run is distinguishable from a family that never ran (no-silence at check-family granularity).

unavailable.description: Present when the backend could not run at all (solver missing, runtime missing, IR unreadable). The stage treats every obligation as unverified by this backend.

crossChecked.description: Which sibling backends were compared, and on which targets. Records the cross-check surface even when no disagreement was found (no-silence).

kind.description: structure-invalid: an artifact violates its own declared well-formedness. reference-broken: an identifier does not resolve where it is declared to resolve. consistency-mismatch: two artifacts/views that must agree, disagree. unreachable: a rule/transition whose guard can never hold (dead), or a state no execution reaches within the bound. redundancy: a rule/transition provably subsumed by a sibling (same trigger, narrower guard, identical effect). refinement-violation: the design admits, reaches, or excludes what the verified requirements forbid/demand under the refinement map. mapping-gap: the refinement map leaves a requirements obligation/scenario/attribute neither mapped, waived, nor in unmapped[]. The first four kinds are the v1 solver vocabulary, unchanged.

frRefs.description: FR/NFR ids implicated, sorted, deduplicated. Traces the finding back to requirements.md.

oneOf.description: A single state (attribute path -> value) demonstrating the finding.
A step-execution trace (state sequence) demonstrating the finding.
An unsat core: the minimal implicated constraint labels (obligation/background/type-bound ids).

Reproducible artifact coordinates for a structural finding: which file and which element (YAML path, table row, or heading anchor) violate the contract. A dependency cycle is one refs array listing the components in cycle order.
Per-backend verdicts for a cross-check disagreement (backend id -> its verdict on the shared target).

unit.description: Unit-of-work this finding belongs to, when the writer aggregates over several units.

reason.description: capability: outside this backend's nature/feature coverage. compile-error: could not be compiled to the backend language. ir-version-mismatch: IR major version unsupported. timeout: per-obligation or per-run budget exhausted. unavailable: solver/runtime absent. waived: a human-gated waiver in the model/map suppressed the check. stale-input: an inputs hash no longer matches the artifact on disk. unrecognized-format: the artifact region a check needs is not in a machine-readable form. absent-input: a sibling artifact the check needs does not exist.

unit.description: Unit-of-work this entry belongs to, when the writer aggregates over several units.
